fields.description: Your Chargebee site subdomain. For acme.chargebee.com, enter acme.
fields.label: Site
fields.name: site

fields.label: Api_Key
fields.name: api_key
fields.source_expression: PieceAuth.SecretText({ displayName: 'API Key', description: 'Go to Settings > Configure Chargebee > API Keys and Webhooks > API Keys tab. Click Add an API Key, select Full-Access Key, and copy the generated key.', required: true, })

auth.method: Provider connection fields; API key or access token

operations.description: Cancel a Chargebee subscription immediately, at end of term, or on a specific date.

inputs.description: When to cancel the subscription. Not applicable when the subscription has a contract term — use Contract Term Cancel Option instead.
inputs.label: Cancel Option
inputs.name: cancel_option

inputs.description: UTC timestamp in seconds for when to cancel. Required when Cancel Option is "Specific Date".
inputs.label: Cancel At (Unix Seconds)
inputs.name: cancel_at

inputs.description: Reason code from Settings > Configure Chargebee > Reason Codes > Subscriptions > Subscription Cancellation. Case-sensitive.
inputs.label: Cancel Reason Code
inputs.name: cancel_reason_code

inputs.description: How to handle credits for current term charges when canceling immediately.
inputs.label: Credit Option for Current Term Charges
inputs.name: credit_option_for_current_term_charges

inputs.description: How to handle unbilled charges when canceling immediately.
inputs.label: Unbilled Charges Option
inputs.name: unbilled_charges_option

inputs.description: Required when the subscription has a contract term. Determines when to cancel the subscription and contract term.
inputs.label: Contract Term Cancel Option
inputs.name: contract_term_cancel_option

inputs.description: How to handle past due invoices when canceling immediately.
inputs.label: Account Receivables Handling
inputs.name: account_receivables_handling

inputs.description: How to handle refundable credits when canceling immediately.
inputs.label: Refundable Credits Handling
inputs.name: refundable_credits_handling

inputs.description: Document date displayed on the invoice PDF. Defaults to the current date. Provide to backdate the invoice.
inputs.label: Invoice Date (Unix Seconds)
inputs.name: invoice_date

inputs.description: When true, all subscription operations will be disabled except deletion. This is irreversible.
inputs.label: Decommission
inputs.name: decommissioned

inputs.description: The unique ID of the charge item price representing the termination fee. Used only when the subscription has a contract term.
inputs.label: Termination Fee Item Price ID
inputs.name: termination_fee_item_price_id

inputs.description: Quantity for the termination fee. Applicable only for quantity-based item prices.
inputs.label: Termination Fee Quantity
inputs.name: termination_fee_quantity

inputs.description: The termination fee in cents. For quantity-based items, this is the fee per unit.
inputs.label: Termination Fee Unit Price (cents)
inputs.name: termination_fee_unit_price

inputs.description: Service period of the termination fee in days, starting from the current date.
inputs.label: Termination Fee Service Period (Days)
inputs.name: termination_fee_service_period_days

operations.name: Cancel Subscription

inputs.description: Optional custom customer identifier.
inputs.label: Customer ID
inputs.name: id

inputs.description: For example: en-US, fr-CA.
inputs.label: Locale
inputs.name: locale

inputs.description: ISO 4217 currency code (e.g. USD, EUR). Requires Multi-currency pricing to be enabled.
inputs.label: Preferred Currency Code
inputs.name: preferred_currency_code

inputs.description: Whether invoices should be automatically charged when possible.
inputs.label: Auto Collection
inputs.name: auto_collection

inputs.description: Number of days within which the customer must pay their invoices.
inputs.label: Net Term Days
inputs.name: net_term_days

inputs.description: Whether the customer can pay via Direct Debit.
inputs.label: Allow Direct Debit
inputs.name: allow_direct_debit

inputs.description: The VAT/tax registration number for the customer.
inputs.label: VAT Number
inputs.name: vat_number

inputs.description: Specifies if the customer is liable for tax.
inputs.label: Taxability
inputs.name: taxability

inputs.description: A customer-facing note added to all invoices for this customer.
inputs.label: Invoice Notes
inputs.name: invoice_notes

inputs.description: Key-value pairs to store extra information on the customer.
inputs.label: Metadata
inputs.name: meta_data

inputs.description: Two-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code (e.g. US, GB).
inputs.label: Billing Address: Country
inputs.name: billing_address_country

operations.description: Create a subscription for an existing customer using a Chargebee item price.

inputs.description: The Chargebee item price ID to subscribe the customer to.
inputs.label: Item Price ID
inputs.name: item_price_id

inputs.description: Whether to automatically charge the customer. Defaults to the customer setting.
inputs.label: Auto Collection
inputs.name: auto_collection

inputs.description: Number of billing cycles before the subscription ends. Defaults to the item price setting.
inputs.label: Billing Cycles
inputs.name: billing_cycles

inputs.description: UTC timestamp in seconds when the trial period ends. Set to 0 for no trial.
inputs.label: Trial End (Unix Seconds)
inputs.name: trial_end

inputs.description: UTC timestamp in seconds when the subscription starts. Defaults to now. Provide a past value to backdate.
inputs.label: Start Date (Unix Seconds)
inputs.name: start_date

inputs.description: A coupon ID or code to apply to this subscription.
inputs.label: Coupon ID
inputs.name: coupon_ids

inputs.description: Purchase order number to associate with this subscription.
inputs.label: PO Number
inputs.name: po_number

inputs.description: Customer-facing note added to all invoices for this subscription.
inputs.label: Invoice Notes
inputs.name: invoice_notes

inputs.description: ID of the payment source to attach to this subscription.
inputs.label: Payment Source ID
inputs.name: payment_source_id

inputs.description: Invoice any charges raised at creation time immediately rather than adding them to unbilled charges.
inputs.label: Invoice Immediately
inputs.name: invoice_immediately

inputs.description: Number of days within which invoices for this subscription must be paid (Net D). Must match a value configured in Chargebee.
inputs.label: Net Term Days
inputs.name: net_term_days

inputs.description: Key-value pairs to store extra information on the subscription.
inputs.label: Metadata
inputs.name: meta_data
